description: §5.2 (Channel B) cites the colony-UBI build target as `skills/econ/ubi` -- 'to build' -- but no such path exists on disk. The actual registry-declared (status:"declared", i.e. stubbed, not built) slot for this exact purpose is `skills/economy/ubi` (note 'economy', not 'econ'), per `skills/registry.json:43-48` ('"economy/ubi": { ... "dir": "skills/economy/ubi", "entrypoint": "ubi.js", "status": "declared", "spec": "27 §3 UBI" }'). Separately, and more confusingly, a DIFFERENT, already fully-built and extensively tested top-level `skills/ubi/` directory exists (distribute-ubi.mjs, bank-watcher.mjs, gmo-furikomi.mjs, kotani-payout.mjs, crossmint-offramp.mjs, gda-distribute.mjs, 12+ test files, RUNBOOK.md) -- this is the human-funded founder's own earn-to-human UBI outflow engine (a different mechanism from the colony gojo/mutual-aid Channel-B this spec describes), not the stub this spec means. A builder following the spec's exact path string could either create a wrong/duplicate directory (breaking the registry SSOT invariant that 'builders only ADD files inside their slot's dir and NEVER edit this registry') or mistake the already-built founder `skills/ubi/` for the colony-Channel-B implementation target.

evidence.snippet: A shared Treasury distributes UBI. (`skills/self/gojo` = "revive a dying AI by sending USDC", `skills/econ/ubi` -- **to build**.)
